questions.q_en: The length of the shadow of a vertical pole on the ground is 36 m. If the angle of elevation of the sun at that time issuch that secθ = 13/12, then what is the height (in m) of the pole?
questions.solution_en:
Since, secθ = 13/12 = Hypotenuse/Base = AC/BC

And the base = the shadow of the pole = BC = 36 m

So, the hypotenuse = AC = 36 X 13/12 = 39 m

And the height of the pole = the perpendicular = AB = √(392 - 362) = 15 m

questions.q_en: Radha and Sita started a business with initial investment Rs. 60000 and Rs. 80000 respectively and after 1 year, Sita left the business and at the same time Mina joins with Rs. 50000. If at the end of three years, the total profit earned by them is Rs. 36000, then what is the average of profit earned by Radha and Mina?
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of profit of Radha, Sita and Mina = (60000 * 3): (80000 * 1): (50000 * 2) = 9: 4: 5

So, required average = (36000/2) * (9 + 5)/18 = Rs. 14000

questions.q_en: Four years ago, A was three times as old as B. Six years from now, A will be twice as old as B. Find their current ages.
questions.solution_en:
Let current ages of A and B are A years and B years.

Now,

A - 4 = 3(B - 4)

=> A = 3B - 8

Also,

A + 6 = 2 (B + 6)

=> A = 2B + 6

So,

3B - 8 = 2B + 6

=> B = 14

A's present age = 34 years

questions.q_en: The digit in the unit's place of (215)33 + (764)68 + (389)127 - (412)54 is -
questions.solution_en:
• (215)33 → last digit 5 → cycle of 5 is always 5

• (764)68 → last digit 4; cycle of 4 is [4,6]; 68/2 = 0 (remainder) → 42 = 6

• (389)127 → last digit 9; odd exponential power → unit digit → 1

• (412)54 → last digit 2; cycle of 2 is [2,4,8,6]; 54/4 = 2 (remainder) → 22 = 4

• Unit digit = 5 + 6 + 1 - 4 = 8

questions.q_en: Pipe P can fill a tank in 20 days. If pipe P is 20% more efficient than pipe Q, then in what time can P and Q together complete the whole work?

Ratio of efficiency of P and Q = 120:100 = 6:5

Efficiency of P and Q together = 6 + 5 = 11 units

Time taken by P and Q together = (6 * 20)/11 = 120/11 = 10(10/11) days

questions.q_en: P and Q together can complete 20% of a job in 4 days. Q and R together can complete 30% in 5 days. R and P together can complete 40% in 8 days. If all three work together, how many days will they take to finish the job?
questions.solution_en:
Let total work = W = 1 unit

Let p, q, r be the daily work rates of P, Q and R respectively.

4(p + q) = 0.2 => p + q = 0.05

5(q + r) = 0.3 => q + r = 0.06

8(r + p) = 0.4 => r + p = 0.05

Sum of all three equations = 2(p + q + r) = 0.05 + 0.06 + 0.05 = 0.16

=> p + q + r = 0.08

Required number of days = 1/0.08 = 12 days

questions.q_en: If (2x - 4y)(4x2 + 8xy + 16y2) = 4a(x3 - by3), then find the value of (a + b - ab).
questions.solution_en:
Given,

(2x - 4y)(4x2 + 8xy + 16y2) = 4a(x3 - by3)

LHS = (2x - 4y)(4x2 + 8xy + 16y2)

= (2x - 4y)[(2x)2 + (2x) * (4y) + (4y)2]

= (2x)3 - (4y)3

= 8x3 - 64y3

= 8(x3 - 8y3)

Now compare with RHS,

We get 4a = 8 or a = 2 and b = 8

The value of (a + b - ab) = (2 + 8 - 16) = 10 - 16 = -6.

questions.q_en: A can finish a piece of the work in 48 days and B can finish it in 36 days. They worked together for 15 days and then A B left. Find the time taken by A to finish the remaining work.
questions.solution_en:
The total work = L.C.M of 48 and 36 = 144

Efficiency = total work/ time taken

Efficiency of A = 144/ 48 = 3

Efficiency of B = 144/ 36 = 4

Work done in 15 days by A and B = 15 * 7 = 105

Work remaining = 144 - 105 = 39

Time taken by A to finish the remaining work = 39/ 3 = 13 days

questions.q_en: If a person invested Rs. 6000 in compound interest at a 20% rate of interest compounded half yearly for two years, then find the compound interest received.
questions.solution_en:
[For half yearly - Time double and the Rate of interest half]

20%/2 = 1/10 and Time = 2 * 2 = 4

C.I = P (11T - 10T)/10T [11 = sum of numerator and denominator of 1/10 and T = Time]

= 6000 * (114 - 104)/104

= 6000 * (14641 - 10000)/10000

= 6 * 4641/10

= Rs. 2784.6

= 51 + 18

= 69 kg

questions.q_en: At each corner of a triangular field of sides 27 m, 36 m and 45 m a cow is tethered by a rope of length 7 m. Find the area (in m2) that cannot be grazed by the cows.
questions.solution_en:
The area of the triangular filed = ∆

= √(s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c))

Where s = ((a+b+c))/2 = ((27+36+45))/2 = 54 cm

Therefore ∆ = √((54)(54-27)(54-36)(54-45))

∆ = √((54)(27)(18)(9)) = 486 sq m

Area of the field that can be grazed by the cows = 1/2π(72) =22/7 * 72/2 = 77 sq.m

Therefore area of the field that cannot be grazed = 486 - 77 = 409 sq m.

Hence the correct option is A.
